arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m."XCL_011" = '+' THEN m."XCL_010" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m."XCL_010") AS percentage
FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m."XCL_010" = a."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m."XCL_010" = b."XCL_005"
WHERE a."XCL_003" = 's' AND b."XCL_006" = '='
